# Channels and the widget

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/api_reference.py from contracts/openapi; do not edit. -->

Base path: `https://<gateway>/channel`. Every call needs an API key or a Studio session (see [Authentication](index.md#authentication)). Request and response fields are in the OpenAPI document, `contracts/openapi/channel.json`.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Returns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/channels` | Channel types this deployment offers. |  | 200 list of `ChannelInfo` |
| `GET` | `/v1/channels/{channel}/agents/{agent}` | What a client of this channel needs to talk to the agent. |  | 200 object |
